# 🚀 MixERP: .NET Framework 4.5.1 → .NET 10 Upgrade Report  
  
## 📋 Executive Summary  
  
MixERP was moved from .NET Framework 4.5.1 to .NET 10 (`net10.0`). This covers 54 projects: 36 libraries, 2 utilities, the web FrontEnd and 15 Web Forms module projects. Upgrade Assistant converted every project to the new SDK project format (0 failures). Kiro CLI then fixed what was left: packages, APIs, hosting and SignalR. ✅ **Result: the solution builds with 0 errors (exit code 0 on all 54 projects) and 0 new warnings.** The 18 warnings left after a clean build all existed before the upgrade. The app keeps its ASP.NET Web Forms UI and runs it on ASP.NET Core through **WebFormsForCore**. Libraries also target `netstandard2.0`, so they can still be used from .NET Framework. ⚠️ The app has not been started or tested at runtime yet (see Next Steps).  
  
## 🏗️ Application Changes  
  
- 📦 **Project files**  
  - All 54 `.csproj` files are now SDK-style; `packages.config` files removed.  
  - Libraries target `net10.0;netstandard2.0`.  
  - FrontEnd and the 8 UI modules target `net10.0`.  
  - The installer targets `net10.0-windows`.  
- 🌐 **Hosting**  
  - IIS/System.Web/OWIN hosting replaced by an ASP.NET Core `Program.cs`, which serves all Web Forms pages through `UseWebForms()`.  
  - `Web.config` and `Global.asax` stay in place; WebFormsForCore still reads them.  
  - New `appsettings.json` holds the Kestrel 1 GB upload limit.  
- 🧩 **Shared build settings**  
  - New `Directory.Build.targets` adds `System.Web` support per framework: WebFormsForCore on `net10.0`, .NET Framework 4.8 reference assemblies on `netstandard2.0`.  
  - It also pins two security patches and works around duplicate-type conflicts.  
  - New `Directory.Build.props` keeps the existing hand-written `AssemblyInfo.cs` files.  
- 📡 **Real-time features:** SignalR 2 (OWIN) replaced by ASP.NET Core SignalR. Hubs are found automatically and mapped to `/signalr/{hub}`. The browser side uses `@microsoft/signalr` 10.0.11.  
- 🗄️ **Data access:** Npgsql 2.2.3 upgraded to 10.0.3 (8.0.9 for `netstandard2.0`). PetaPoco now creates its database connections without `DbProviderFactories`.  
- 🔧 **Fixes for Linux builds:** wrong letter case in `ProjectReference` and `.sln` paths corrected.  
  
## 🛠️ Tools Used  
  
- ⚙️ **.NET SDK 10.0.402** (SDKs 5–8 also installed)  
- 🔄 **Microsoft .NET Upgrade Assistant 1.0.518.26217**  
  - Upgraded all 54 projects in place to `net10.0` and the SDK project format.  
  - Every project reported "0 failed".  
- 🤖 **Kiro CLI 2.14.2** with model **claude-opus-5.5**  
  - Fixed the remaining build errors and warnings, and wrote this report.  
  - Session: 54 min 46 s, 214.88 credits, succeeded on the first attempt.  
- 📚 **Supporting sources**  
  - Migration knowledge base, CodeKB index of the original code, NuGet/npm registries.  
  - CodeKB was used to map the original code before each change.  
  
## 💻 Code Changes  
  
- 🐘 **Npgsql API updates**  
  - `UserName` → `Username`.  
  - Removed `SyncNotification` and `SSL` (replaced by the existing `SslMode.Prefer`).  
  - `NpgsqlException.Code` → `PostgresException.SqlState`.  
  - `NpgsqlError` → `PostgresNotice.MessageText`.  
  - Npgsql's legacy timestamp mode is turned on so dates and times behave as before.  
- 📡 **SignalR:** 4 hubs moved to `Clients.*.SendAsync`. The 2 master pages and 3 pages/scripts moved from `$.connection` to `getHub().on/.invoke`. The existing Forms Authentication login is passed on to hub connections.  
- 📝 **Logging:** Serilog 1.5 `RollingFile` → Serilog 4.4 with the `File` sink (daily rolling).  
- 📄 **Library replacements**  
  - MarkdownDeep → Markdig.Signed 1.4.0.  
  - HtmlRenderer.WinForms → HtmlRenderer.PdfSharp 1.6.1. The checklist e-mail now attaches a **PDF** instead of an image.  
- 🔐 **Security and obsolete APIs**  
  - Removed `[AspNetHostingPermission]`, `[PermissionSet]` and `[SecurityPermission]` attributes; they have no effect on .NET 10.  
  - Removed the old binary-serialization members from `MixERPException`.  
  - `SHA512CryptoServiceProvider` → `SHA512.Create()`; the hash output is identical.  
  - `WebClient` → `HttpClient` (3 places).  
- 📁 **File helpers**  
  - The writable-folder check now actually tries to write a file; before, it always returned true.  
  - The Visual Basic `CopyDirectory` call is replaced by an equivalent recursive copy.  
- 🧱 **Platform and API compatibility**  
  - `#if NETSTANDARD2_0` code paths added for `DbProviderFactories` and `HttpUtility`.  
  - Windows-only `System.Drawing` code marked `[SupportedOSPlatform("windows")]`.  
  - Methods that expose Npgsql types marked `[CLSCompliant(false)]`.  
- ↩️ **Reverted bad automated edits:** a broken `Headers["User-Agent"]` rewrite in 3 files was restored to the original `UserAgent` code.  
- 🗑️ **Removed:**  
  - Unused IE `WebBrowserImageSerializer`  
  - OWIN `Startup.cs`  
  - Old Npgsql `DbProviderFactories` entry in `Web.config`  
- 📊 **Footprint:** 151 files changed (+1,298 / −10,173 lines, mostly old project-file boilerplate) and 8 new items.  
  
## ⏱️ Time Savings Estimate  
  
- 📐 **Scope:** 54 projects, about 1,000 C# files, 245 `.aspx`/`.ascx`/`.master` files, and changes across Web Forms, SignalR, Npgsql, logging, cryptography and packaging.  
- 👩‍💻 **Manual estimate:** about **15–25 engineer-days**. That covers project-file conversion, package research, `System.Web` hosting design, per-framework fixes and the SignalR rewrite.  
- ⚡ **Automated run:** about **1.5 hours** end to end (09:28 → ~10:53 UTC). Upgrade Assistant ran first, then the 55-minute Kiro session.  
- 💰 **Estimated saving:** about **90–95%** of the effort to reach a working build.  
- 🧭 Rewriting the Web Forms UI as Razor Pages or Blazor was avoided for now. That rewrite would add several engineer-months.  
  
## ✅ Next Steps  
  
- 🧪 **Runtime smoke tests**  
  - Sign-in and session, page routes, ASMX services, `WebResource` / `ScriptResource.axd` scripts.  
  - The handlers registered for IIS in `system.webServer` (`Resources.js`, `FileUploadHanlder`). If WebFormsForCore ignores them, move them to `system.web/httpHandlers`.  
- 📡 **Refactor the SignalR hubs**  
  - They still read the user through `HttpContext.Current`, which is always null inside ASP.NET Core SignalR calls.  
  - End-of-day, backup and update actions will fail until they get the user and database from `Context.User`.  
- 🗄️ **Database regression tests:** check date/time values, error-code mapping (`DbErrors`) and SSL settings on PostgreSQL with Npgsql 10.  
- 🐧 **To run on Linux:**  
  - Move image code from `System.Drawing` to SkiaSharp (KB 21).  
  - Configure a font resolver for PDF generation.  
  - Rework the `pg_dump.exe` / `.bat` backup in `DbHub`.  
- ⚠️ **Dependency risk:** WebFormsForCore is maintained by one person. Plan a gradual move of pages to Razor Pages or Blazor.  
- 🧹 **Cleanup**  
  - Delete the unused jQuery.signalR scripts and bundles, `src/packages`, `lib/HtmlRenderer`, and the unused `ExpressionHelper.Eval` (it relies on CodeDom compilation, which .NET 10 doesn't support).  
  - Fix the 18 remaining older warnings.  
- 🧾 **Tests and CI:** there are no C# test projects yet. Add xUnit tests for the changed helpers (`FileSystemHelper`, `DirectoryHelper`, `DownloadUpdate`, `PetaPoco.Factory`) and set up CI builds for both target frameworks.

  - Caveat: Static behavioural judgement of the before/after implementation, not an executed test.
